patches.name: Marketplace only
patches.description: Opens Facebook directly on Marketplace and (optionally) hides the bottom tab bar. Built for Facebook 582.0.0.50.54 (com.facebook.katana).

options.title: Hide bottom tab bar
options.description: Hides the Facebook tab bar (Feed / Reels / Watch / Notifications / Menu) so they aren't one tap away. Turn off to only change which tab opens at launch.

options.title: Lock navigation to Marketplace
options.description: Disables swiping between tabs and the left-hand Facebook menu (hamburger button and edge swipe), so Reels, Groups, Dating etc. can't be reached from the main screen.

options.title: Open links in the system browser
options.description: Never use Facebook's in-app WebView browser; every link opens in the default browser app.

options.title: Block Reels / fullscreen video viewer
options.description: Reels (and any other video opened in Facebook's fullscreen Watch/Reels viewer) can no longer be opened from feeds, profiles, deep links or notifications.

options.title: Marketplace is the home tab
options.description: Back on Marketplace's root leaves the app instead of jumping to the Facebook Home feed.

options.title: Never switch away from Marketplace
options.description: Redirects every tab switch to Marketplace, including Facebook's "return to Home feed after being away" reset, so coming back to the app after a long time still shows Marketplace.

options.title: Always use dark mode
options.description: Pins Facebook's own Dark mode setting to "On" and makes the dark-theme decision points (is-dark check, theme application, FDS resolver) always dark, regardless of the system theme.

options.title: Remove group suggestions
options.description: Removes the "Recommended groups" block on Marketplace search and the "Related groups" block on listing pages (Facebook's GYSJ units) by switching their MobileConfig flags off.

options.title: Keep search inside Marketplace
options.description: Removes the "Search in all of Facebook" and "Search with Meta AI" entries from Marketplace search, and blocks every other way into Facebook global search (e.g. profile > More options > Search).

options.title: Hide profile "Go to settings" note
options.description: Removes the paragraph with the "Go to settings" link on the Marketplace profile screen.

options.title: Add an About page to the account menu
options.description: Adds an "About" row to the list that opens from the top-right account button on Marketplace. It opens a dialog describing this app.

patches.name: Marketplace rename
patches.description: Changes the package name to io.focalpoint.prism, the app name to Marketplace and the launcher icon to a storefront (all configurable), so the patched app installs next to the stock Facebook app. Uses the "Clone app" patch for the package name.

options.title: Package name
options.description: Package name of the patched app. Must be unique on the device.

options.title: App name
options.description: Name shown under the launcher icon and in the system app list.

options.title: Change launcher icon
options.description: Replaces the launcher icon with the bundled Marketplace storefront icon.
